name: Language Spoken at Home and English Ability
description: Comprehensive demographic survey estimating primary non-English languages spoken in American households, multilingual proficiency rates, and English-speaking proficiency levels across distinct geographic cohorts.

name: Chronic Disease Indicators and Hospitalization Prevalence
description: Cross-sectional public health indicators monitoring major chronic conditions including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, asthma, obesity, and preventive health screenings among adult populations.
source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

name: Public High School Graduation and Dropout Statistics
description: Annual longitudinal records tracking cohort graduation rates, state diploma completions, career technical certifications, and district-level dropout statistics for secondary education institutions.

name: Fair Market Rents and Housing Affordability Metrics
description: HUD fair market rent determinations across bedroom counts (efficiency through 4-bedroom) combined with area median family income ratios and rental voucher payment standards.
source: U.S. Dept of Housing & Urban Development (HUD)

name: County Employment and Wage Quarterly Census
description: Comprehensive market census of employment and total wages reported by employers, categorized by NAICS industry supersectors, monthly payrolls, and average weekly earnings.

name: Median Household Income and Poverty Thresholds
description: Detailed multi-year estimates on household median income distribution, Gini inequality coefficients, and federal poverty thresholds categorized by household age and size.

name: Healthcare Provider Shortage Areas and Facility Access
description: Designations of primary care, dental health, and mental health professional shortage areas (HPSAs) alongside travel time indices to regional trauma centers.

name: Postsecondary College Tuition and Student Debt Burden
description: Integrated postsecondary data tracking undergraduate in-state and out-of-state tuition, net price after institutional aid, median student loan debt, and repayment metrics.

name: Residential Building Permits and New Construction Starts
description: Authorized single-family and multi-family residential building permits, total valuation estimates, and construction starts across metropolitan statistical areas.

name: Consumer Price Index and Inflation Breakdown
description: Monthly measure of the average change over time in the prices paid by urban consumers for a market basket of consumer goods and services including shelter, food, and energy.

name: Age, Sex, and Race Population Projections (2020-2050)
description: Demographic forecasting models modeling domestic net migration, fertility trends, mortality expectations, and elderly dependency ratios across US territories.

name: Health Insurance Coverage and Uninsured Rates
description: Population health coverage status examining employer-sponsored, Medicaid, Medicare, Affordable Care Act Marketplace enrollment, and direct purchase insurance plans.

name: K-12 STEM Proficiency and Standardized Assessment Scores
description: National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP) evaluations quantifying 4th and 8th grade mathematics, reading, and scientific literacy achievement milestones.
source: National Assessment of Educational Progress (The Nation's Report Card)

name: Homelessness Point-in-Time Census and Shelter Capacity
description: Continuum of Care (CoC) counts of sheltered and unsheltered individuals experiencing homelessness, including chronic homelessness, veteran populations, and unaccompanied youth.
source: U.S. Dept of Housing & Urban Development (HUD AHAR)

name: State Gross Domestic Product and Industry Output
description: Real and nominal gross domestic product (GDP) categorized by 21 industry sectors, along with personal income per capita and state-level value added components.

name: Urban-Rural Domestic Migration and Commuting Patterns
description: Interstate and inter-county migration flows derived from administrative tax records and ACS surveys, examining net population shifts into sunbelt and suburban regions.

name: Opioid Overdose Mortality and Prescription Drug Monitoring
description: Vital statistics monitoring mortality rates associated with synthetic opioids, prescription analgesics, illicit substances, and emergency naloxone administration events.
source: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

name: Early Childhood Education Enrollment and Head Start Access
description: Pre-kindergarten and early childhood development program participation rates, Head Start funding allocations, teacher-to-child ratios, and socioeconomic eligibility indices.
source: U.S. Dept of Health & Human Services (ACF)

name: Home Price Index and Mortgage Delinquency Rates
description: Quarterly repeat-sales single-family house price indices (HPI), 30/90-day mortgage default rates, foreclosure inventories, and local price-to-rent multipliers.

name: Small Business Lending and Federal Reserve Credit Flow
description: Small business commercial loan originations, CRA-eligible lending under $100k/$250k/$1M, business establishment creation counts, and interest rate spreads.
source: Federal Reserve Board & Small Business Administration (SBA)
